R-N2.backend_finding: handleSecondConfirm (grants.ts:1162) does NOT re-run validateAdminDelegation for the second confirmer — enforces only distinctness over authenticated principal ids (actor !== proposed_by && actor !== confirmed_by). Admin authority of the second actor is NOT re-checked. The UI hint text 'проверяется бэкендом' is a user-guidance statement; it technically overstates the backend enforcement. This is a deliberate T-0044 rev-2 design decision (R-AUTH §9.6 notes the second-confirm path 'only checks distinctness over the DB row'). Flagged as candidate follow-up — see handoff_candidates below.

handoff_candidates.description: handleSecondConfirm does not validate admin authority of the second confirmer — only enforces distinctness. A non-admin authenticated user can serve as the second confirmer on a dual-control escalation. The first-request validateAdminDelegation gate does not cover the second actor. This gap is intentional in T-0044 rev-2 (the assumption is that the second actor is also an authenticated principal with implicit authority). If the product requires admin-authority enforcement for the second confirmer, a follow-up task should add a validateAdminDelegation call in handleSecondConfirm before the UPDATE.
handoff_candidates.proposed_resolution: Add loadAdminContext + validateAdminDelegation call inside handleSecondConfirm before the confirmed2_by UPDATE. Alternatively, document the current behaviour as 'distinctness-only, no admin-re-check' in the ADR and accept it.

dual_control_demo_steps.persona: Persona A (e.g. e-owner or any user with admin rights)
dual_control_demo_steps.action: Navigate to /rights/editor. Select a role. Add a grant with resource_type=effect_resource, operation=invoke (this triggers external_invoke axis escalation). Click Сохранить. The response should show a dual-control banner: 'Требуется подтверждение второго аппрувера'.

In the confirmActor input, enter the SAME actor id as Persona A (e.g. 'e-owner'). Click Confirm2. Backend returns 409 DUAL_CONTROL_UNSATISFIED/self_confirm. UI shows error reason. This confirms self-confirm is rejected.
In the confirmActor input, enter a DIFFERENT actor id (e.g. 'e-owner2'). Click Confirm2. Backend returns 200 and the grant transitions to confirmed. Banner shows green confirmation.

founder_walkthrough.r_n1_note: ra-shell.jsx is a standalone preview harness intentionally kept for design iterations. It is NOT imported in the production AppShell. The header comment documents this.
founder_walkthrough.r_n2_note: The dual-control banner in /rights/criticality now shows the hint 'Второй подтверждающий обязан иметь admin-полномочия — проверяется бэкендом.' Note: the backend enforces distinctness only for the second actor (not re-validates admin authority). See handoff_candidates for the open design question.
founder_walkthrough.gate_outcome: If the founder confirms the rights-panel UX and dual-control flow on dev, T-0137 can be merged to dev.
